Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Question raised at the 2007 EC:
> I control the Madness Network. My prey controls a ready untapped Malkavian. On
> my turn, when I finish with my minion phase actions, can my prey's Malkavian
> take an action via my Network?

Yes.
Madness Network's "another Methuselah" means "other than the controller of the
Malkavian in question", not "other than the controller of the Madness Network".

Relevant card text: "After another Methuselah has finished all of his or her
minion phase actions, any untapped Malkavians (going clockwise) can take actions."
